g.aria-label: Publication Line Charts: d2l.plot & Narrow-Decade Log Tick Placement
Accepts 1D array or list of curves for X, Y
If Y is None: plots X against index 0..n−1
Renders crisp vector SVG figures by default
Standard log axes show only 10^k powers,
Why 1–2–5 Log Ticks Matter in Chapter 13 & Scaling Plots:
Roofline sweeps and batch-scaling plots spanning 2×–20×
stay immediately readable without grid guessing.
